source: Continuation of requested numbers lesson using offer prices
summary: Correctly formed 270, 268, 478 and 568 after vocabulary models. Initially answered target 750 as valid 700; retry seteciento cinquenta needed spelling corrections. Next seicientos cincuenta retained corrected cincuenta but needed seiscientos. Correctly recalled quinientos cincuenta after intervening exercises. No long-term retention inferred.

observations.outcome: Correct immediate use of setenta after vocabulary supplied.

observations.correctedText: El precio es de doscientos sesenta y ocho euros.
observations.outcome: Correct transfer to 268; sesenta and y placement correct after prior vocabulary.

observations.outcome: Correct transfer to 478 after cuatrocientos supplied.

observations.learnerText: El precio es de setecientos euros

observations.correctedText: El precio es de setecientos cincuenta euros.
observations.outcome: Hundreds-plus-tens structure correct; missing final s in setecientos and q in cinquenta corrected.

observations.correctedText: El precio es de seiscientos cincuenta euros.
observations.outcome: Cincuenta spelling correction retained; seicientos corrected to seiscientos, retaining seis + cientos. No corrected seiscientos retry yet.

observations.learnerText: el precio es de quinientos cincuenta euros
observations.correctedText: El precio es de quinientos cincuenta euros.
observations.outcome: Quinientos recalled correctly after several intervening number exercises without a fresh hint; corrected cincuenta retained. Within-session recall, not long-term mastery.

observations.tutorText: 60 sesenta; 70 setenta; 300 trescientos; 400 cuatrocientos; 500 quinientos; 600 seiscientos; 700 setecientos. Setecientos has sete-, not siete-. Seiscientos retains seis + cientos.
observations.outcome: Vocabulary supplied; trescientos introduced only and not attempted.

nextSteps: Recall seiscientos and setecientos after a gap, keeping final s and complete seis.
Continue numbers for conversational prices; next hundreds 800/900 have not yet been taught in this batch.
Keep earlier soporte técnico spelling review.
assessmentNote: Immediate practice and within-session recall recorded separately; trescientos remains introduced only.
